assets.prompt: Photorealistic distant environment plate for an interactive Japanese RPG inspired portfolio hero. Vast quiet stone desert viewed from a low sheltered ledge, distant weathered sandstone mesas on the far right horizon, pale warm dusty sky and subtle windblown haze, muted ochre and sand colors. Quiet uncluttered darker rock shadow on left half for separate website copy. Natural late-afternoon sunlight from upper left, authentic geological erosion, restrained saturation, fine sand texture. Wide landscape 1536x1024. Background only: NO close foreground rocks or objects, NO arch, NO compass, no animals, no person, no UI, no text, no buildings, no fantasy glow, no painted/cartoon rendering, no HDR. Leave space for separate arch and sandbank cutouts to be composited in front.

One production cutout asset, actual transparent alpha background: a large naturally eroded sandstone arch with asymmetric pillars and a broad irregular open center, isolated entire formation, roots of both rock pillars visible. Three-quarter slightly low camera view, natural warm late-afternoon sunlight from upper LEFT. Real photographic granular sandstone, horizontal strata, cracked edges, warm ochre with subdued brown shadows, restrained saturation. Ground-level geological form, not a manmade gateway. No floor/background/sky, no scenery through the opening: opening truly transparent. NO flora, animals, people, text, magical glow, ornaments, vignette or cast shadow on a background. Tall-ish square canvas. This standalone realistic rock will occupy the right side of a layered desert hero. Avoid AI fantasy illustration, impossible stone geometry, plastic CGI or HDR.

Side view from slightly above, ground plane recedes away from camera. Wide landscape canvas, continuous solid bottom but transparent sky above the irregular crest, natural late-afternoon light from upper LEFT. Photographic ochre sand granules and eroded rock texture, restrained saturation, realistic scale. No background, no sky, no distant scenery, no compass, no plants, no animals, no lettering. No plastic CGI, painterly fantasy or ground shadow outside the cutout. This is a separate foreground terrain layer, not a complete landscape.

Photographic material detail, warm afternoon sunlight from upper LEFT. Actual transparent alpha background, no surface, no sand, no cast shadow outside object. Entire object visible with generous margins. Square canvas. No text or letters, no extra objects, no hand, no glow, no fantasy embellishments, no glossy CGI. Production object sprite.

Natural restrained wildlife macro photography, warm soft desert light from upper LEFT. Entire beetle visible on actual transparent alpha background, no ground or shadow or sand. Square canvas, no text, no additional insects, no cartoon, no shiny toy CGI, no fantastical colors. Small separate creature for a sandbank environment.

A single small shallow oval mound of fine ochre desert sand, isolated production cutout on actual transparent alpha.
